violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM ONSITE AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. PIC HAS EMPLOYEES SCHEDULE TO TAKE A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER EXAM ON THE 11TH. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION AND THAT A CFM IS ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' OBSERVED NO EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY IN PLACE AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. PIC HAD ALL STAFF SIGN COPIES OF THE EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE KEEP SIGNED COPIES ONSITE AT THE ESTABLISHMENT.

out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: Food employee was observed handling the following ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands: OBSERVED EMPLOYEE CUTTING ORANGE SLICES WITH BARE HANDS THAT WERE INTENDED TO BE ADDED TO A WATER DISPENSER.
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. PIC DISCARDED OF ORANGE SLICES DURING INSPECTION. EHS DISCUSSED PROPER HANDWASHING AND GLOVE-USAGE..

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED CUT SAUSAGE AT 64F, SPINACH AT 62F, AND EGGS AT AMBIENT TEMPERATURE NEAR THE OMELETTE STATION AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC PUT FOOD ITEMS IN A COOLER TO COOL RAPIDLY. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD NOT BE LEFT OUT AT ROOM TEMPERATURE; ICE BATHS MAY BE USED OR FOOD CAN BE PUT ON TIME IF THE ESTABLISHMENT WISHES TO IN THE FUTURE. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: OBSERVED COMMERCIALLY VACUUM-PACKAGED SALMON THAWING IN THE FOUR-DRAWER COOLER IN INTACT PACKAGING.
violations.corrective_action: EHS PROVIDED GUIDANCE. PIC REMOVED SALMON FROM PACKAGING DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: OBSERVED APPROXIMATELY 10 FRUIT FLIES AT A DRIP TRAY AT THE BAR.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PIC CLEANED THE DRIP TRAY DURING THE INSPECTION. PLEASE PROVIDE THE EHS WITH A PEST CONTROL INVOICE BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly: OBSERVED THE DISHWASHING MACHINE MEET MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 151.7F (FIVE CYCLES). OBSERVED THE QUATERNARY AMMONIA DISPENSER DISPENSING SANITIZER AT TOO HIGH OF A CONCENTRATION.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC WILL ENSURE A TECHNICIAN REPAIRS THE DISHWASHING MACHINE AND THE THREE-VAT SINK IS USED FOR THE TIME-BEING. PIC WILL ENSURE WATER IS BEING ADDED TO THE SANITIZER FOR THE TIME-BEING UNTIL A TECHNICIAN CAN REPAIR THE DISPENSER.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED A Y SPLITTER INSTALLED AT THE MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. PIC REMOVED Y SPLITTER DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS APPROVED DEVICE SHOULD BE ORDERED IF TWO FAUCETS ARE NECESSARY. WOODLAND PARK ROAD (Inspection Date: 10/02/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: OBSERVED PREP SINK IN THE BACK KITCHEN NOT AIR-GAPPED.
violations.corrective_action: An air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the plumbing fixture, equipment, or nonfood equipment shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply inlet and may not be less than one inch. PIC PLACED A WORK ORDER DURING THE INSPECTION TO REPAIR THE SINK. PLEASE PROVIDE EHS WITH PROOF THAT THE SINK HAS BEEN REPAIRED BY NOVEMBER 2ND.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Protective Shielding on Light Bulbs
violations.observation: Observed that the end caps are missing from the protective light covering of fluorescent light fixtures in the MEN’S RESTROOM.
violations.corrective_action: Provide end caps to completely enclose the light bulb. PLEASE SHIELD THIS LIGHT AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.
